objective: Cross-domain validation of typed hierarchical token-state flow on natural-language modeling.
scientific_question: Under a matched backbone, tokenizer, dataset, parameter budget, training exposure, and inference budget, does typed hierarchical token-state flow improve constrained language generation without material NLL regression?

budget_contract.parameter_scope: unique trainable parameters including embeddings, output projection, typed adapters, hierarchy heads, and decoder heads

hierarchy.name: document_plan
hierarchy.role: global topic, intent, length, and required entities

hierarchy.name: segment_structure
hierarchy.role: paragraph, section, clause, and discourse roles

hierarchy.name: token_span_surface
hierarchy.role: surface token and span flow state

hierarchy.name: symbol_execution_engineering_anchors
hierarchy.role: symbols, API relations, tests, build/runtime feedback, and engineering constraints

promotion_gates.G0_LEAKAGE: No target text, reference label, oracle plan, or test metric is available at inference or selection.
promotion_gates.G1_MATCHING: Shared backbone, tokenizer, data, exposures, optimizer, and sampling budget are hash- or value-identical.
promotion_gates.G1B_CORPUS_BUDGET: Unique trainable parameters equal total corpus tokens divided by 20 within 2%.
promotion_gates.G4_TASK: constraint_success or another preregistered task metric improves by at least 0.05 with a paired 95% bootstrap interval excluding zero
promotion_gates.G5_COST: candidate decoder work <= 1.10x control at the primary endpoint
promotion_gates.G6_REPLICATION: the direction persists on at least two validation seeds and a frozen unseen suite

forbidden_claims: superiority over untuned public chat models
constraint validity obtained only through hidden retries
any transfer claim without the matched control
GPT-class parameter/data scaling as the main contribution
absolute SOTA against models outside the declared low-capability class

engineering.evidence_boundary: This config establishes a plan and contract only; it contains no language-quality evidence.
